items.headline: UAE Interest Rates Expected to Remain Unchanged Today
items.summary: Analyst predictions suggest the US Federal Reserve will maintain current rates without reductions. Borrowers in Dubai must wait longer for potential mortgage relief.
items.why: Interest rate stability directly dictates borrowing costs and mortgage affordability for real estate buyers.
items.impact_reason: Affects mortgage affordability and buyer borrowing costs.

bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, down 3.1% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales accounted for 69.2% of the total, above the 7-day average of 65.2%.
The median price was AED 1,720 per sq ft, up 4.3% over the 30-day average and 1.0% higher than last year.
Dubai South led 7-day sales with 290 transactions, followed by JVC with 188 and Majan with 126.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1BR apartment median rent reached AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: UAE interest rates are expected to remain unchanged today, keeping borrowing costs and mortgage affordability stable for buyers.
